validationMode: stream every JSONL record, validate the declared source shape, parse every logical representation, retain only aggregate evidence for protected test files

sourceAnomalies.condition: NRule metadata differs from the number of rule objects
sourceAnomalies.handling: Rows remain preserved and schema-valid. The validator reports the metadata inconsistency rather than deleting or silently correcting source data. This test-only variant is not used by the development baseline.

testBoundary: Test files were parsed only by the deterministic host schema validator. Their text, labels, questions, proofs, per-answer counts, and rows were not printed, sampled, sent to Coding Agent, or used to select a mechanism.
